definition: the old reflexes a remembered thing still sets off, when nothing else replays

settled:
A taste I cannot bring back still crinkles my face, at about a fifth of the strength.

Smells, sights, textures and sounds do the same. The sensory content is gone and the body still reacts.

Only disgust carries this second, older track. None of the other five basic feelings has anything like it.

As a present feeling disgust is ordinary, built the same way the rest are. Moral disgust off a thought I am having now is just a present feeling. What is unusual is the track beside it, not what kind of thing disgust is.

title: What Still Fires Off A Memory
